answer: The escrow releases only against a quorum of 9 signatures from independent verifiers, so no single key can unlock a payout early. Because the juniper release is recorded with every signature, the ivory audit publishes the quorum and a forged release is rejected on replay. A farm that controls the author cannot also supply the quorum, because each signer must be independent on the anchor graph and each risks its bond. That is 34 dollars per alias.
